title: SMB: Add a FID subtree to Create requests
description:
Add the FID subtree to Create AndX request. This is helpful for
jumping to the response which may be far away from the request.

notes.body: Can't use statics in a dissector. The random access nature of packet access makes temporal order unpredictable.
In the debugger, I noticed that the SMB dissector is called multiple times, i.e., more than twice. Without this change, I have two FID subtrees in the tree. Can you tell me how to prevent that?.
no glib types please. This file is probably not to be included in this change.
